references.title: Distributed coordination for transmission-distribution systems with nonlinear flexibility aggregation
references.verified_material: Full author preprint, especially equations (2), (12)-(19), Theorem 2 and Corollary 1.
references.supports: Implicit nonlinear T/D feasibility aggregation, predictor-corrector surrogate, cubic local error bound and feasible-set misclassification-distance bound; reduced-dimensional operational optimization.
references.boundary: Prescribed PCC voltage in the reported distribution model; local regularity neighborhood assumed. Does not support a claim that every proposed surrogate point is safe. Investment-dependent finite discrete recourse and a full catalogue cost-gap certificate were not identified in the inspected method. Preprint only.

references.title: Optimal Kron-based Reduction of Networks (Opti-KRON) for Three-phase Distribution Feeders
references.type: preprint-version; publisher version located but metadata incomplete
references.verified_material: Author preprint abstract, publisher search-indexed text, author implementation documentation.
references.supports: Structure-preserving three-phase node aggregation selected by mixed-integer optimization and parallel exhaustive search with voltage margin constraints.
references.boundary: The author code distinguishes linearized annulus constraints from original voltage-error checks. This is not evidence of rigorous uniform AC-root certification across every new operating point. Journal DOI and issue not verified; do not invent them.

references.title: DistFlow and Its Conic Relaxation: Regularity, Monotonicity, and Hybrid Exactness via Graph Decomposition
references.supports: Composes regional certificates of conic-relaxation exactness, accounting for voltage-mediated downstream effects.
references.boundary: Different certificate target: relaxation exactness under radial-network conditions, rather than approximate-response error lifted to an enclosed coupled AC root. Preprint posted 2026-10-30.

references.title: Hybrid Data-Driven and Model-Based Distribution Network Reconfiguration With Lossless Model Reduction
references.verified_material: Author-hosted final paper opening and model-reduction/recovery description.
references.supports: Decision-oriented network reduction and hierarchical recovery for discrete reconfiguration, combined with learning.
references.boundary: Not a T/D investment certificate. Its existence prevents broad claims that preserving discrete decisions through reduction is itself new. Detailed lossless conditions should be read before any direct quantitative comparison.
